integrity: Finite exact modular checks supplement an explicit infinite polynomial proof; no independent audit performed. The 2012-09-20 date is the earliest day-verified public supporting-source date used for classification, not the date of the 1991 predecessor.
scientific_limitations: Only first-kind Dickson parameter one, odd primes at least five and degrees equal to powers of the same prime; no extension to all Dickson degrees or unramified Galois extensions. A related 1991 paper proves noncritical multiplicity and bounds critical image size; historical priority for implicit equivalent formulations remains uncertain.
title: Exact odd-prime ramified images and fibers of prime-power Dickson maps
